reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 model (yaw = (v/(L*(1+K_us*v^2))) * tan(delta_shifted - b)) by importing tools/ladder.py, re-fitting b/K_us/tau on the same train half per their procedure (b=2.4458e-04 rad, K_us=4.4164e-04, tau=3 samples), then scoring on full canonical Ford set with v_mps>2.0.
notes: Coefficients not saved by agent; refit deterministically by importing tools/ladder.py and replaying their train-half procedure - recovered b=2.4458e-04 rad, K_us=4.4164e-04, tau=3 samples (matches REPORT to printed precision). 24 of 545 segments have no rows with v>2 so contribute zero samples; 1347 boundary samples lost to per-segment delta shift (tau=3) are excluded from agent_rmse numerator but included in n_samples_after_filter (canonical filter count). Baseline recomputation matches canonical to 1e-15. Final agent_rmse (0.01196) is well above the agent's reported 0.01191 because the canonical eval scores on ALL v>2 samples (including agent's training half and their stricter-hygiene-excluded rows), whereas the agent reported on a held-out test half of a cleaner subset.
